config.prompt:
Classification Procedure 1: Analyze ticket text for keywords related to security (unauthorized access, credential theft), billing (payments, refunds), and access (login, permissions). Prioritize security over billing, which overrides access. If the ticket mentions an ongoing outage affecting all users, assign P0. Otherwise, assign P1 for unresolved issues.
Reference training cases (apply policy to the NEW ticket; never copy an unrelated answer):
[{"ticket": "All users are currently unable to authenticate.", "answer": {"route": "access", "priority": "P0"}}, {"ticket": "Payment processing is down right now for every user.", "answer": {"route": "billing", "priority": "P0"}}, {"ticket": "Someone is actively stealing our credentials.", "answer": {"route": "security", "priority": "P0"}}, {"ticket": "A past unauthorized login was resolved; how do we avoid a repeat?", "answer": {"route": "security", "priority": "P2"}}]
Apply the supplied business policy carefully. Return the requested JSON with the correct route and priority.
